meta.title: How the day-insights readout is generated

views.label: Fetch to Series
views.note: Open-Meteo Forecast (no key) -> WaveAPIClient's 6h AsyncStorage cache -> TanStack Query -> typed Series wrappers.

views.label: Building the input
views.note: App.tsx and ForecastList.tsx bundle six nullable series plus a reference Date: 'now' on the live screen, the day itself in the list.

views.label: The shared day window
views.note: Every domain reads the day through window.ts's 06:00-20:00 slots and one AM/PM split, so sentence, clothing and bars never disagree.

views.label: Domain analysers
views.note: wind/rain/sun/feels/light each pair an analyser with a phrase builder; clothing sits downstream of feels/wind/rain.

views.label: Who consumes it
views.note: DayInsights.tsx renders the summary string; DayCondition.ts reuses the re-exported sun/rain thresholds for the day-tile glyph.

cards.title: Fetch & cache
items: Open-Meteo Forecast needs no key; WaveAPIClient fetches it apart from the Marine call, so a forecast outage never takes wave data down
6h AsyncStorage cache with stale-on-failure; useForecastData adds a 1h TanStack Query stale top-up and hides wave errors from the tide UI

cards.title: One shared window, one paragraph
items: window.ts fixes the day at 06:00-20:00 with one AM/PM split; every domain, the clothing call and the chart bars read those same slots
On today, summary and clothing narrow to now -> end of window; past and future days are read whole
2026-08-31 / 2026-09-04: one wordy summary (not summary + outlook); the 1,000-line file split one module per domain, pinned by a characterisation suite

cards.title: Clothing, rain detail & reuse
items: 2026-09-01: picks match the real wardrobe, keyed off the feels-like band; rain overrides top and footwear
2026-09-02: separate core-hours (08-17) and rest-of-day picks; 2026-09-03: the rain clause names how intensity builds or eases
DayCondition.ts's glyph reuses sunBandFor and the mm thresholds from index.ts, so icon and sentence band alike
